dict.string: SR Companion reads your selected Apple Health data for your private dashboard. It does not write or change data in Apple Health.
Scan the pairing QR code on your Strange Ramblings dashboard to connect this iPhone.
Sync the health categories you choose to your private Strange Ramblings health dashboard. Family members cannot view your health data.
Share your current location with members of your Strange Ramblings family.
Keep your family location updated when the app is closed, using more frequent records while moving. You can pause sharing at any time.
Connect to your Strange Ramblings test server on your local network.
